description: Defines a template FactoryType class for creating and managing factory objects, including nested classes for factory instances and iteration, with methods for creation, destruction, and access of factory elements.

classes.name: FactoryType
classes.description: A template class managing a collection of factory instances, allowing creation, destruction, and iteration over factories.

classes.name: FactoryType::Iterator
classes.description: A nested class providing iteration over the factories stored within FactoryType.

classes.name: FactoryType::IFactory
classes.description: An interface for factory objects, providing methods to get elements and query created/queued elements.

classes.name: FactoryType::InternalFactoryType
classes.description: A template class implementing IFactory, managing a pool of factory elements.

methods.name: DestroyFactories
methods.description: Deletes all factory instances managed by FactoryType.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Deletes a specific factory identified by its ID.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance for a specific element type, with optional initial queue size.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a proxy to a factory element by identifier.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Returns a proxy to a factory element by identifier.

methods.name: Factories
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all factories.
